definitions.ask: Should dashboard NEXT and PENDING turn red only when their displayed section count exceeds the cap?

choices.label: Yes: color section/cap; retain whole-lane pressure in tooltips and daily/CLI warnings.
No: show and color whole-lane count/cap; move the section count into the tooltip.

definitions.why: Makes NEXT 10/15 non-red as requested and keeps badge counts aligned with their sections.
